message.content: Painting the entire Eiffel Tower is a massive undertaking that depends on many variables—crew size, equipment, weather, and whether you’re doing a full repaint or just touch‑ups. In practice, the tower’s iron framework is repainted roughly every 7–10 years as part of routine maintenance. A full repaint of the whole structure typically takes **about 2–3 weeks** when a dedicated crew works continuously (often around 8–10 hours per day). If you’re planning a one‑off project, you’d need to factor in prep work, scaffolding, safety inspections, and potential delays due to wind or other conditions.
